fusions.name: Flag-Tail Jab
fusions.desc: A quick jab for 7 piercing damage that leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, after which you move 15% faster for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Royal Rack
fusions.desc: Lowers the branching tines and sweeps everything within 3 tiles ahead for 26 piercing damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Bound Clear
fusions.desc: Springs 2 tiles clear of where you stood, then moves 35% faster with 10% more dodge chance for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: First to Notice
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
